intro: Yojamba Isle is a cluster of small tropical islets off the northwestern coast of Stranglethorn Vale, near the waters leading up to Westfall. It serves as an offshore encampment for the scholarly Zandalar Tribe, who have established a foothold here to observe the growing crisis in the jungle. From these shores, the Zandalari seek willing champions from both the Horde and the Alliance to confront the ancient horrors awakening in Zul'Gurub.

p: While most trolls encountered across Stranglethorn Vale are hostile to outsiders, the Zandalar tribe dwelling on Yojamba Isle maintain an uneasy neutrality. As the ancient priests and lorekeepers of troll civilization, the Zandalari have watched with mounting dread as the Gurubashi trolls within Zul'Gurub turned to Hakkar the Soulflayer. Knowing the world-ending danger a fully summoned blood god represents, the Zandalari have ventured far from their ancestral home to establish this staging ground, calling upon any capable adventurer—regardless of faction—to aid in curbing the threat.

The island rests quietly along the coastline northwest of the Vile Reef and the ruins that haunt the mainland beaches. To the north lies the massive hidden sea-gate of Ironclad Cove, while the surrounding shallows are frequented by wandering sea beasts. Despite its precarious location, the Zandalari camp functions as a tranquil sanctuary where exotic rituals, sacred altars, and ancient knowledge provide solace and power to those preparing to march deep into the jungle's darkest ruins.
